decision: Keep the optimization: a modest, measured reduction in public JavaScript with unchanged CMS output and retained preview child state.
scope: Lazy-load Storyblok editable attributes and their MutationObserver. Both builds include the earlier preview-context optimization and the existing page/theme working-tree changes.

implementation.description: Keep the two template markers, their refs, and CMS children synchronous. Load a null-rendering sibling controller with next/dynamic and ssr:false. Move the original attribute/observer effect unchanged into that controller, including metadata updates, root replacement, ownership checks, and cleanup.
implementation.previewTiming: Editor attributes become available after the controller downloads. CMS content renders immediately; downloading the controller does not replace or remount that content. The preview-context and native AppContext override logic is unchanged.

footprint.method: Sum separately compressed distinct shared _app and catch-all JavaScript files from each production build manifest using Node gzipSync and brotliCompressSync. These are compressed file sizes, not measured HTTP transfer sizes.
footprint.browser: All eight route/viewport samples requested one fewer script and 1309 fewer gzip-compressed bytes, including route-specific runtime differences. No candidate public sample requested a chunk containing the editor marker implementation.

controllerChunk.note: This is the controller chunk alone, not the total preview dependency graph.

unit.newCoverage: A deferred controller import verifies no public import, immediate preview content, retained DOM/input/component state, metadata changes during download, unmount before completion, root replacement, and cleanup.
unit.testAdjustments: Existing marker assertions wait for the dynamic import. The existing intermittent GoogleFontsLivePreview test now waits for its loadable subscription to commit the expected DOM effect; font runtime code is unchanged.

validation.typecheck: pnpm run check-types and both production builds passed.
validation.lint: oxlint and oxfmt --check passed for all seven changed TypeScript files; git diff --check passed.

builds.result: Both fresh builds passed. TEST=TRUE selects four CMS SSG routes rather than enumerating every published route.
builds.comparison: The #__next body markup and all Emotion style text are byte-identical.

productionPreviewFixture.reason: An isolated Next fixture imports the actual repository source through a symlink outside the fixture root. The real-site builds use Turbopack.

browser.navigation: Client navigation from homepage to detail and back passed at both widths in both builds.
browser.drawer: Mobile drawer opened in both builds; its screenshots matched.

pixels.method: Count pixels with an RGB channel difference greater than 16; allow zero changed pixels. Fix the clock, stop carousel autoplay, disable animations, and serve identical YouTube iframe documents while waiting for their loading skeletons to disappear.
pixels.initialDifference: 3338 mobile-homepage pixels confined to Chatwoot's asynchronous fixed chat button and shadow (x 291-354, y 816-887).
pixels.followup: Repeat the mobile homepage comparison after the real Chatwoot open button is visible in both builds. Button geometry, markup and styling match; full-page screenshots have zero changed pixels. No page region was masked.

browser.existingAssetIssue: Both builds had the same two broken images on the mobile German route; no new broken images appeared.

limitations: Coverage is the four sampled routes in this repository configuration, not every consumer site. The preview browser fixture exercises real production code with a delayed chunk, but does not connect to a live Storyblok Visual Editor session. Existing bridge and context override tests pass. No field LCP/INP improvement is claimed.
